answer: Identities enter in rings of six: three established sponsors vouch for each newcomer after 30 days of interaction, each risking 500 stake plus two epochs of rewards if it proves fake. A sponsor may vouch for two newcomers per epoch, so 100 fake seats need 50 sponsor slots. The ring is a haven for the honest: one exposed fake sends an echo through all six, slashing every sponsor, while clean agents wander on.
